business_summary: Hubbell Incorporated is a Connecticut-headquartered, NYSE-listed electrical and utility solutions company organized in Utility Solutions and Electrical Solutions segments. Utility Solutions supplies transmission, substation, distribution, telecommunications and grid-automation equipment to electric utilities; Electrical Solutions supplies wiring devices, connectors and lighting to industrial, commercial and data-center customers. Both mapped links sit inside Utility Solutions.

exposure_summary.narrative: Hubbell sits on the chain's money corner (power-equipment) and on grid-interconnect, both scored UNDISCOVERED. Its own second-quarter 2026 release attributes roughly 65% year-over-year growth in data-center sales to capacity additions and content gains in high-amperage applications, and management now guides to about 50% full-year data-center sales growth; the company frames this as a named, disclosed growth driver rather than an incidental one.

expectations_gap.basis: The reverse DCF in data/market/HUBB.json quality.reverse_dcf solves a 17.92 percent free-cash-flow CAGR over a five-year explicit period on base FCF 874700000 at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth. The achieved three-year revenue CAGR to fiscal year 2025 is 5.71 percent from companyfacts. Recorded plainly rather than smoothed over: the market-implied bar sits well above the growth Hubbell has actually delivered, roughly 3.1 times the achieved revenue CAGR. This is the opposite reading from MYR-GROUP, whose implied bar sat near its achieved growth. Whether the gap is closed by the newer data-center growth leg outrunning the legacy utility base, or is a genuine expectations problem, is Stocky's question; this dimension states the measured gap and does not adjudicate it.
expectations_gap.horizon_caveat: The horizon spread is 7.03 percentage points (17.92 percent at five years against 10.89 percent at ten, same price and base cash flow). Per method section 7 a claimed gap smaller than that spread is a statement about horizon convention, not about price; any gap Stocky claims on this name must exceed 7.03 points or must say which horizon it is claiming.
expectations_gap.assumption_caveat: The discount rate and terminal growth are assumed, so both reverse-DCF fields are tagged SPECULATIVE in the confidence audit. This dimension records the measured expectation state only; the deep-dive stage adjudicates whether the price is wrong.
